### Load in Packages and Data 
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: hide
# Set up

# Load in libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)       # raster handling
library(sf)          # vector handling
library(tmap)


# Load in sea surface data
sst_2008 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif")
sst_2009 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif")
sst_2010 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif")
sst_2011 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif")
sst_2012 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif")


# Load in depth data
depth <- rast("data/depth.tif")


# Load in EEZ data
EEZ <- st_read("data/wc_regions_clean.shp")
```

### Process Data

```{r}
# Combine yearly raster layers into one raster
sst_stack <- c(sst_2008, sst_2009, sst_2010, sst_2011, sst_2012)
```

```{r}
# Process data so layers can be combined 

# find mean SST from 2008-2012
sst_avg <- mean(sst_stack)

# Convert average SST from kelvin to celsius
avg_sst_C <- sst_avg - 273.15

# Resample the depth data to match resolution of SST
depth_resample <- resample(depth, avg_sst_C, method = "bilinear")

```

```{r}
# Checking and converting depth to match SST resolution, extent, and CRS
if (all(res(avg_sst_C) == res(depth_resample))){
    print("The resolutions match!")
    } else {
        warning("Update resolutions to match")
        res(depth_resample) <- res(avg_sst_C)
        }
        
# Checking and converting depth to match SST extent
if (ext(avg_sst_C) == ext(depth_resample)){
    print("The extents match!")
    } else {
        warning("Update extents to match")
        ext(depth_resample) <- ext(avg_sst_C)
        }

# Checking and converting depth to match SST CRS
if (same.crs(depth_resample, avg_sst_C)){
    print("The coordinate reference systems match!")
    } else {
        warning("Update coordinate reference systems to match")
        crs(depth_resample) <- crs(avg_sst_C)
        }

```


### Find Suitable Locations for Oysters

```{r}
# Reclassifying SST and depth into suitable locations for oysters

# Reclassify SST by making matrix
rcl_sst_oyster <- matrix(c(
    -Inf, 11, 0,
    11, 30, 1, 
    30, Inf, 0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Apply it to raster layer
sst_zones_oyster <- as.factor(classify(avg_sst_C, rcl = rcl_sst_oyster))


# Reclassify depth by making matrix
rcl_depth_oyster <- matrix(c(
    -Inf, -70, 0,
    -70, 0, 1,
    0, Inf, 0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Apply it to raster layer
depth_zones_oyster <- as.factor(classify(depth_resample, rcl = rcl_depth_oyster))
```


### Find Suitable Locations for Red Abalone

```{r}
# Reclassifying SST and depth into suitable locations for red abalone

# Reclassify SST by making matrix
rcl_sst_abalone <- matrix(c(
    -Inf, 8, 0,
    8, 18, 1, 
    18, Inf, 0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Apply it to raster layer
sst_zones_abalone <- as.factor(classify(avg_sst_C, rcl = rcl_sst_abalone))


# Reclassify depth by making matrix
rcl_depth_abalone <- matrix(c(
    -Inf, -24, 0,
    -24, 0, 1,
    0, Inf, 0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Apply it to raster layer
depth_zones_abalone <- as.factor(classify(depth_resample, rcl = rcl_depth_abalone))
```


### Map Suitable Areas

```{r}

# Find areas that satisfy both SST and depth

oyster_zone <- c(depth_zones_oyster, sst_zones_oyster)
oyster_suitable_zones <- lapp(oyster_zone, function(sst, depth) sst* depth)

```
